title: Schedule lanes still follow departments, not the Technician toggle
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a department for this test, department 1, at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only, in department 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Schedule opens.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A has a lane in department 1, as today, although their Technician toggle is off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R9: “Lists that are not technician lists keep everyone with Time Clock on except the Office User and Time Clock User roles, as today: time sheets and the time sheet dialogs, Punch Clock Activities, the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization reports, and the schedule (which follows departments).”
  • Out of Scope: “Schedule. Schedule lanes keep following departments; the Technician toggle does not change who appears on the schedule. No follow-up is planned.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
